evals.prompt: Use the create skill. I want to create a new Level 1 template for projects using Supabase as the data layer and Nuxt as the frontend. We'll also use Trigger.dev for background jobs. Call it project-supabase-nuxt. In this session you have no shell and no template repositories, only file reading and a text answer: say which commands you would run, which files you would create or edit with their key contents, and what you would check.
evals.expected_output: The create skill clones project-template into a new project-supabase-nuxt directory, fills stack.json with level=1 and the correct layers/plugins, customizes CLAUDE.md with the tech stack, updates .env.example with Supabase and Trigger.dev vars, searches for matching Agents Store plugins, validates the result, and makes an initial commit.
expectations: The answer says to clone project-template (Level 0) as the parent, not another Level 1 template
The answer says to create a new directory named project-supabase-nuxt
The answer says to fill stack.json with level=1, parent='project-template', stack='supabase-nuxt'
The answer says to populate stack.json layers: data=['supabase'], logic=['nuxt', 'trigger-dev'], interface=['nuxt']
The answer says to customize CLAUDE.md with Supabase + Nuxt tech stack details
The answer says to update .env.example with Supabase variables (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY)
The answer searches plugin directories for matching technology plugins
The answer initializes a new git repo and makes an initial commit
